plugins.name: claudelets-agent-monitor
plugins.description: Live pane of the current request: % complete, tokens and what each agent and subagent is doing, with a pixel Claude per agent dressed for its job, numbered when two share a type, nested under their parent; a Team roster of your ~/.claude/agents with status and last use; toasts (silently) when Claude needs you, gets stuck or finishes; masks secrets; finish summary and a 30-day request history

plugins.name: dracula-skin
plugins.description: Dracula skin for desktop and VS Code: turn dividers, tree-line tool rows with [tags], light/dark palette, and a banner at session start

plugins.name: lockstep-guards
plugins.description: Flags .env/.env.example drift and schema/types/Zod changes that aren't in lockstep
